verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's docs say a Bot can save a multi-step path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule. A dedicated skills, routines and automations page shows a recurring weekday 8:00 AM routine and event-triggered routines, and a month-long user confirms each bot owns its own routines. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off run. missing for 10: documentation on managing schedules (editing, pausing, run history, failure handling, schedule syntax) and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs actually firing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Walk a Bot through a multi-step path once, and it can save the path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule.
Cursor account integrations can start a routine from an event, such as a Slack message or a GitHub notification.
each bot owns its own routines, context and domain
